title: Golden-prompt accuracy runner for FP8/INT8 quant profiles
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build an automated accuracy validation harness that runs golden prompts against quantized model variants (FP8 and INT8) and enforces pass/fail gates before model promotion. The runner must compare outputs to FP16/FP32 baselines using a battery of metrics, support per-prompt and aggregate thresholds, and integrate with CI, Canary rollouts, and the Console dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Harness can load a baseline (FP16) and target variants (FP8/INT8) and run a configurable golden-prompt set; 2) Computes pre-specified metrics (token-level KL, top-k accuracy, exact-match, BLEU/ROUGE, MRR where applicable, and likelihood-drop) per prompt and aggregate; 3) Applies statistical tests (bootstrap CI, paired t-test) and fails the job if any metric crosses the configured gate; 4) Outputs machine-readable artifact (CSV/JSON) and links to Grafana summary; 5) Runs in CI and as nightly scheduled job; 6) Docs and a demo PR exist.
implementation_notes:
- Runner implemented in Python (pytest + harness runner module) with a lightweight worker that sends batched requests to local runtime or hosted endpoint.
- Use existing quant-calibration outputs (scale/zero-point artifacts) to parameterize the runtime.
- Golden-prompt set stored in Drive (grouped by task: instruction-following, summarization, QA, code) and sampled deterministically for CI.
- Metrics library will reuse eval utils from research repo but add token-KL and likelihood-drop calculation.
- Default pass/fail gates: median token-KL < 0.15, aggregate exact-match drop <= 2%, BLEU drop <= 3 points, bootstrap 95% CI for delta excludes negative impact beyond thresholds.
- Provide configurable per-customer tolerance profile for Dedicated/Private rollouts.
- Potential trade-off: tighter gates reduce rollout speed; allow opt-out flags for developer experiments.
tests:
- Unit tests for metric calculations and statistical tests.
- Integration test that runs harness against a toy GPT model quantized to INT8 and FP8 (small params) and validates artifact schema.
- CI job template that fails on gate violations and posts annotated summary to PR.
- Nightly full-run across curated golden-prompt sets for regression tracking.

notes_summary: This ticket builds the validation runner that gates quantized model promotion by comparing outputs against baselines on curated golden prompts. Emphasis on reproducibility, statistical significance, and machine-readable artifacts for downstream dashboards and rollouts. Will enable automated quality gates for FP8/INT8 profiles across Hosted, Dedicated and Private deployments.
